segments.text: Carpathy's LLM wiki idea turned into a productionready app. Tallaria is an offline first knowledge base for Mac OS and Linux. Plain markdown files in a
folder. Get backed with autosync. Notion style feel. Total file ownership. The killer feature is the MCP server registration. Claude code and openclaw
read, search and update your knowledge base directly while you work. Your second brain accessible to every agent in your workflow.
